searchText: So the key fix for Teku syncing devnet-1 has now merged to master branch. So you can use the `consensys/teku:develop` docker image rather than having to build from source. Also I hear from the ACD notes that geth got optimistic sync working with teku? That's very cool but I can't reproduce it locally. Any particular config or branch required on the geth side? I have a local branch I can push it tomorrow Cool. No rush. It's already the weekend here, I'm just excited to see it work. 🙂 This branch should work for optimistic sync: https://github.com/MariusVanDerWijden/go-ethereum/tree/fix-optimistic-sync
